description: Join PDFs into one in the order given, taking all pages or chosen ones from each. With a single file it reorders, repeats or drops pages. Price: $0.01 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Document tools: Work with PDFs and scans: read the text out of a PDF with page numbers and metadata, recognize the text in a scan, photo or screenshot, merge PDFs, take or reorder pages, split into parts, and turn images into a PDF..

files.description: PDFs in the order they should appear. The same file may be listed twice with different pages, which also reorders or drops pages of one document.

pages.description: Pages to take, like "1-3,5,8-". All pages when omitted.

name: doc_tools_pdf_merge
